name: Sole Prop
values: Sole Prop
Questions
Answers
Notes
Do you have an Employer Identification Number (EIN)?
What is the official name of your business, if different from your personal name?
Do you use a personal vehicle for your business? (If yes, is it used exclusively for business or shared for personal use?)
How do you track business-related travel (e.g., mileage trackers, logbooks)?
Do you have a dedicated home office space?
Is the space used solely for business purposes (i.e., no personal use)?
What types of expenses do you associate with your home office (e.g., internet, utilities)?
Do you use personal equipment like a computer or phone for your business?
Do you have Self-Employed Health Insurance (SEHI):
Do you pay for your own health insurance through your business? (If yes: “Does it cover just you, or your family too?)
Did you have large medical or dental bills that weren’t covered by insurance? (Over $1000)
Do you have a Health Savings Account (HSA), and did you contribute or use it for medical expenses?
Do you provide health insurance or other benefits to your employees?
Do you offer anything like dependent care help or education reimbursements?
Do you contribute to a retirement plan, like a SEP IRA or Solo 401k?
Did you put money into a traditional or Roth IRA?
Did you withdraw money from retirement accounts, pensions, or Social Security?
Do you offer any retirement benefits to employees or contractors?
What is your filing status — single, married filing jointly, married filing separately, or head of household?
Did you live at the same address all year?
Did you live outside the U.S. or have any foreign property or bank accounts?
Do you have any dependents? If yes, how many and what are their ages?
Do you have kids that might qualify you for child tax credits or dependent care credits? (do you know if you qualified for these credits in the past?)
Did you or a dependent have any tuition or school-related expenses?
Did you (or your spouse) have any W-2 jobs this year?
Did you change jobs or have any unemployment during the year?
Did you earn money from side jobs, freelancing, or consulting?
Did you get any income from investments like dividends, interest, rental property, or selling stocks?
Did you receive any other income — like alimony, gambling winnings, or unemployment?
Do you pay alimony under a divorce agreement from before 2019?
Do you think you may qualify for the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)?
Do you own a home and pay mortgage interest or property taxes?
Did you sell a home this year?
Did you make any energy-efficient home upgrades, like adding solar panels?
Do you qualify for any other credits, like education credits or adoption credits?

name: SCorp  CCorp  Partnerships
values: SCorp / CCorp / Partnerships
Questions
Answers
Notes
Has your S-Corp election (Form 2553) been approved by the IRS?
If yes, request a copy of prior return or any letters from the IRS about this and show them how to upload
Who are the shareholders, and what percentage does each one own?
Did the business change ownership percentages or transfer shares during the year? (Yes/No)
If yes, provide the details of ownership transfers
Did any shareholders also work in the business?
Do you have a shareholder agreement in place? (Yes/No) if yes, upload to intuit link please
If partnership, are you making Guaranteed Payments to any of the partners?
If S-Corp, are you currently paying yourself through payroll?
If yes: “What amounts and when?”
How was this salary determined (e.g., market rate, percentage of profits)?
What other benefits did they receive, like health insurance, or retirement?
Did the business pay any distributions to shareholders (other than salary)?
Were payroll taxes filed (Forms 941 and 940)? (Yes/No)
Did any shareholders make loans to or receive loans from the company? (Yes/No)
If yes, provide the terms, balances, and repayment schedules. (Upload in Intuit)
Does the business own capital assets used personally by shareholders / officers (vehicles, office space)
If yes, describe the asset and the nature of its use.
Did the business file its previous year’s S-Corporation return (Form 1120S / 1065 / 1120)? (Yes/No)
Did the business receive any IRS or state tax notices last year? (Yes/No)
If yes, provide details and the resolution status.
Is the business currently under audit? (Yes/No)
